args.query: WITH base AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY JV_default_PCE) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS tot, JV_default_PCE AS v, Ref_ID AS rid, Ref_DOI_number AS doi FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture='nip' AND ETL_stack_sequence='TiO2-c | TiO2-mp' AND HTL_stack_sequence='Spiro-MeOTAD' AND JV_default_PCE IS NOT NULL) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base) AS n_pce_rows, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rid) FROM base) AS n_distinct_refid, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT doi) FROM base) AS n_distinct_doi, (SELECT AVG(v) FROM base WHERE v>0) AS mean_positive_only, (SELECT AVG(v) FROM base WHERE tot%2=1 AND rn=(tot+1)/2) AS median_odd_tot, (SELECT AVG(v) FROM base WHERE tot%2=0 AND rn IN (tot/2, tot/2+1)) AS median_even_tot
